title: Feedback:Game updates/20260302
wikitext:
== Update March 2, 2026 ==

* [[Guild Wars]] will now always run from the executable directory it was started in rather than trying to run from the "installed" directory as specified in the registry.
** This helps players keep their first-party ArenaNet login install and a Steam install separate.
* Fixed a bug where you could complete the [[A Bastion In the North]] quest even if [[Devona]] died.
* Disabled access to the [[Shrine to Godly Accoutrements|Shrine of Godly Accoutrements]] for [[PvP character]]s.
* Disabled the highlight effect on the new start mission button for certain mission types (such as Guild Battle).
* New start mission button won't capture mouse clicks when disabled.
